title: CanvasXpress Dashboard Spec
description: Declarative spec describing panels, layout, and data bindings for a CanvasXpress dashboard.

id.description: Stable dashboard identifier. Defaults the broadcast group.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this JSON Schema (https://canvasxpress.org/schema/dashboard.schema.json), for editors and validators.

schemaVersion.description: Spec FORMAT version, MAJOR.MINOR (absent = 1.0). MINOR bumps are additive (a reader renders what it knows); MAJOR bumps are migrated on load. Current: 1.1 (1.0 + join/function sources, relationships, Filters panels). Not the dashboard's own revision — that is `version`.

version.description: The dashboard's own revision counter (author-managed). Distinct from schemaVersion, the format version.

broadcastGroup.description: Coordination domain isolating this dashboard's panels. Defaults to id.

background.description: CSS color applied to the dashboard container background.

backgroundImage.description: Background image URL or data URI (rendered cover/centered behind the panels).

canvasInset.description: Margin in px left around each panel's CanvasXpress graph.

width.description: Explicit dashboard width (number = px, or any CSS length). Unset = fill parent.

height.description: Explicit dashboard height (number = px, or any CSS length). Unset = content height.

maxWidth.description: Cap on dashboard width for wide screens (number = px, or any CSS length); the dashboard is centered when capped. Unset = 1600px default. Set 0/false/"none" to fill the parent uncapped.

data.description: Named, reusable data sources referenced by panels via dataRef.

panels.description: Panel definitions keyed by panel id.

relationships.description: How sources relate, for cross-source marking and filtering without blending: a selection (or a filter-control pick) in one source marks (or filters) the related rows of the panels bound to the others. Every kind:join source implies one too.

filterSchemes.description: Named filter states offered by Filters panels (type:filters). Each is an array of saved filters.

markingMode.description: How panels on related sources show marked rows (CanvasXpress highlightMode): focus greys the rest, highlight recolors the marked rows, ghost fades the rest.

params.description: Named dashboard parameters written by mode:'param' controls and read by data sources via $name tokens in their query. Each value is a bare default or a { value, type } object.

kind.description: inline = literal value; connector = fetched URL; dataset = stored dataset by id; join = two other sources blended on a key; function = an R / Python snippet run by a data-function runtime over other sources.

id.description: Dataset id (kind:dataset). Resolved to GET /api/datasets/{id} with credentials (cookie auth). Keeps specs path- and credential-free.

store.description: Optional named dataset store to resolve the id against (server-configured; Phase 5.2).

url.description: Connector endpoint, e.g. /api/data?source=sales, or a signed dataset URL. Fetched with credentials (cookie auth).

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in ms for this connector source (0 = no cross-render caching).

refresh.description: Poll interval in seconds; refetches and live-updates bound panels.

headers.description: Optional extra request headers for the connector fetch.

query.description: Request params merged into the fetch URL. Each value is a literal or a "$name" token resolved from spec.params; a token whose param is null/unset is dropped (widens the query). Different resolved values are distinct cache entries.

axis.description: Row axis: smps = one row per sample (connector/CSV tables); vars = one row per variable (scatter orientation, e.g. genes or cells as points). The axis name is also the key meaning 'the row id'. For kind:join, the axis of both inputs (and of the output).

leftAxis.description: kind:join — row axis of the left input (overrides axis; the output follows it). Defaults to the left source's own axis.

rightAxis.description: kind:join — row axis of the right input. Defaults to the right source's own axis.

left.description: kind:join — ref (in spec.data) of the left input. Any source kind, including another join.

right.description: kind:join — ref (in spec.data) of the right input.

on.description: kind:join — the key. The row id ("smps" or "vars", per axis) is the default; any other string names a variable or x annotation present on both sides; {left, right} maps differently named columns; an array of those is a composite key. Keys compare as strings; a missing key never matches.

how.description: kind:join — inner keeps matched rows; left/right also keep that side's unmatched rows; outer keeps both.

suffix.description: kind:join — appended to a right column whose name clashes with a left one. Defaults to ".<right ref>".

code.description: kind:function — the snippet. Inputs arrive as pandas DataFrames / R data.frames named after `inputs` (row ids as index / row names; numeric columns + row annotations as columns) and `params` holds the resolved args; it must assign `result` (a table, or a CanvasXpress data object).

inputs.description: kind:function — the sources it reads: an array of refs (each becomes a variable named after the ref) or a {variableName: ref} map.

args.description: kind:function — values passed as `params`: literals or "$name" tokens resolved from spec.params (a change re-runs the function).

runtime.description: kind:function — the runtime URL (POST {language, code, inputs, params, axis} -> {data}). Defaults to the dashboards server's /api/functions/run (enabled with CXD_FUNCTIONS).

dependsOn.description: Param names this source depends on beyond those named in query (so a param change triggers a refetch).

on.description: The key, as for kind:join: the row id by default, a shared column, {left, right}, or an array (composite).

axis.description: Row axis of both sides (defaults to each source's own axis).

oneOf.description: A field of the panel's dataRef.

field.description: A row annotation, numeric column, or the row id ("smps"/"vars").

dataRef.description: Source of the field; defaults to the panel's dataRef.

kind.description: Widget: checkbox list, min/max range, or contains-search. Detected from the data when absent.

values.description: Keep rows whose value is one of these.

text.description: Keep rows whose value contains this (case-insensitive).

type.description: Panel variant: absent = graph; 'text' = free-form text; 'control' = annotation-filter widget; 'image' = a picture (URL or data: URI); 'filters' = a Filters panel (multi-field filter inspector with filter schemes). Text and control panels float free (may overlap graph panels).

src.description: Image panels: the picture's URL or a data: URI. Empty renders a placeholder.

transpose.description: Graph panels: swap the data's samples and variables before charting. Absent = automatic: a Scatter2D / Scatter3D / ScatterBubble2D / KaplanMeier / Pie whose xAxis / yAxis name only variables (table columns) is transposed, so it plots one point (or slice) per row; so is a Pie with no axis named, one variable and several rows.

fields.description: Filters panels: the fields to filter. Absent = every row annotation and numeric column of the panel's dataRef.

saveSchemes.description: Filters panels: show the name box + Save button for saving the current filters as a scheme.

fit.description: Image panels: CSS object-fit — how the picture scales within its (resizable) cell. 'contain' fits whole; 'cover' fills and crops.

alt.description: Image panels: alternative text for accessibility.

href.description: Image panels: optional link opened in a new tab when the image is clicked (http/https/mailto/tel or relative; unsafe schemes are dropped).

compartment.description: Control panels: which metadata compartment the annotation lives in — 'x' (sample annotations) or 'z' (variable annotations). The builder detects this from the chosen annotation, and the renderer falls back to the other compartment when the stored one has no values.

annotation.description: Control panels: the single annotation name whose unique values populate the widget. Selecting a value calls modifyFilter('guess', annotation, 'like', value) serially on every instance in the dashboard.

mode.description: Control panels: 'filter' (default) filters the data already on the page; 'param' writes a dashboard parameter (see spec.params) so sources consuming it re-query the backend and bound panels live-update; 'config' drives a target panel's live config via updateConfig — each option carries a config fragment, and controls targeting the same panel merge their current fragments.

param.description: Control panels (mode:'param'): the spec.params name this control writes. 'All' clears it (null), widening the query.

target.description: Control panels (mode:'config'): the panel id whose config this control drives (updateConfig).

options.description: Control panels: choices. For mode:'param', a static list of primitives (an 'All' entry is prepended automatically). For mode:'config', an array of {label, value, config} objects whose 'config' fragment is applied to the target panel when chosen. Either way the control needs no data of its own.

optionsFrom.description: Control panels (mode:'param'): populate choices from a dataset's distinct annotation values instead of a static list.

annotation.description: Annotation/field whose unique values become the choices.

disabled.description: Control panels: render read-only (ignores input). Set automatically on param controls in a self-contained export, where no backend is reachable.

value.description: Control panels: the pre-selected value (used to pin a disabled/snapshot param control to the value in effect at export time).

style.description: Control panels: widget rendering. 'auto' picks buttons for ≤4 values, a dropdown above that. 'search' (param controls) is a debounced free-text box whose value becomes the parameter. 'slider' (config controls) is an ordered range over the options.

placeholder.description: Control panels (style:'search'): placeholder text for the search box.

debounce.description: Control panels (style:'search'): ms to wait after the last keystroke before applying (default 250).

align.description: Text/control panels: horizontal alignment of the content within its grid cell.

valign.description: Text/control panels: vertical alignment (baseline) of the content within its grid cell.

measures.description: Numeric variable names to plot (projects the source to these columns). Empty/absent = all variables.

clickParam.description: Graph panels: clicking a mark sets this dashboard parameter to the clicked value (cross-filter), re-querying dependent sources. Must name an entry in spec.params.

clickField.description: Graph panels: which annotation/field of the clicked mark supplies the clickParam value (defaults to the clicked sample name).
